evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Do you have any specific concern or stressors about the moving process in general? [Asked after Nicole had already provided minimum pricing and discussed item weight limits]

evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection provided; concerns acknowledged but not summarized or confirmed

evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Minimum of two and a half hours with two movers and one truck = $510 everything included. No personalization to this customer's specific concern (time/complexity of the route)
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or any check-in on the pricing before moving to Two Promises
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full delivery: 'if we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full delivery: '$2,000 per move to repair, replace or reimburse for any accidental damages' — no deductible or fine print framing mentioned, built into rate (stated as 'included')
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No ask of 'Does that put those to rest?' — moves directly to 'do you have any questions or anything for me?'
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Only 'do you have any questions or anything for me?' which is the default throwaway version
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' — ends with 'I look forward to getting you a quote then' which is a statement, not a close
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: 'no deposit required if you have to reschedule or cancel no fees for that either'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial: date (Sept 30, 2:30 PM window 1:30–3:30), phone (best number confirmed), addresses, crew size (2 movers + 1 truck) all confirmed. Missing: detailed notes left for crew about customer concerns (the multi-stop route complexity, the weight/size of items)

top_strength: Nicole clearly documented all logistics details (addresses, dimensions, parking, floor level) and delivered both Two Promises guarantees in full, building strong trust around damage coverage and timeliness.
coaching_note: Skip the minimum pricing pitch before asking about concerns—ask 'What else do you want answers to on this call?' first, then tailor your scope. You also never asked for the business: end with a clear 'Would you like our help with your move?' instead of assuming the quote email is the close.
